evidence.description: Configuration and Property Size: Due to high property values in Malad West, there is a huge demand and supply of smaller-sized and mid-sized homes. While the average property in the West is approximately 500-1000 sq. ft., Malad East offers a 1000-1500 sq. ft. unit size. Malad West has more one-bedroom units than Malad East. In addition, the team of 2BHK is famous in both areas. Age of Property: Malad West is older than East, 49 percent of properties in West are 5-10 years old, and 15 percent of new constructions are in the area. Malad East offers 30 percent of new buildings and a majority (39 percent) of properties less than five years old. [...] A look at Malad East and West A look at Malad East and West A view of the Malad skyline A look at Malad East and West A look at Malad East and West Below provided are some striking differences between Malad West and East. Average Capital Values: The average property values in West Malad ranges from INR 17,000-20,000 per sq. ft., whereas in the East, the values are lower and range between INR 15,000-18,000 per square. feet. Average Rental Values: Since Malad West is a prime location compared to Malad East, the average rental deals in the West are higher than in the East. Whereas Malad West commands an average rent of INR 37,000 per month for 1 BHK to INR 1.7L for 3 BHK, Malad East offers rental accommodations between INR 25,000 per month for 1 BHK to INR 1L for 3 BHK. Along with its attraction, Malad is in close proximity to commercial centers and IT as well as non‑IT business parks, while being well connected to the central city. One of the primary reasons for the strong demand for houses in Malad is its proximity to the Commercial Zone (Andheri) and Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC). Additionally, with its location just 13 km from the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Airport, 1 km from the adjoining railway station, and 2 km from the Western Express Highway, it is also a strategic choice to invest in commercial property in Malad.
